mintAuthority.summary: D14 review 2026-10-03: verified USDfr.mint(address,uint256) is onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) but performs _mint without the ReserveManager backing check used by the present controller. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE grantRole can authorize a different minter once accrual is idle. This minter-authorization path, not UUPS upgrade alone or oracle admission, makes economic cap unbounded. The fallback is unbounded-adverse; internal-ledger accounting does not qualify for a reconciliation uplift. Existing unresolved upstream root/custody questions remain; no D29 certificate is authored.

review.evidence: The earlier USDfr grant/revoke replay identifies MintRedeemController 0x50ac018eb6400f247ffe0fa7f1d4e0e900cdb47c as MINTER and timelock 0x28b36b6a48ed3f7409464c811a9ed538a824120e as DEFAULT_ADMIN/UPGRADER. New Ethereum block 26122339 research resolves the previously suspected oracle address conflict: ClaimBridge.modules() binds proxy 0xb53977a70d755a56d3ce26926acb4c33f7861c61, whose EIP-1967 implementation is the previously cited 0x870deb459512099e70e9a640cf3140a0d969fc18. Complete proxy RoleGranted/RoleRevoked logs over deployment block 26006832 through 26122339 identify attesters 0x759c2cd90594fdb114c5d37c5c3ea78a0033ed35 and 0xe2e544eded1189b8a5bda86a6f474011a397efb0; proxy threshold reads return one for kinds 0/1 and two for kinds 2-9. Timelock role logs over the same complete interval identify only the timelock itself as DEFAULT_ADMIN, FRGovernor 0x6cbb4ca6769dd4b57f51d1e62a000110b7fd2d1b as proposer/canceller, and address zero as open executor. Pinned membership confirms the initial admin 0x89575b4fcfe2cf6833e96de71765c6ad15eac11b is revoked; getMinDelay is 172800. Treasury Safe 0x0687a13c490b2573d4666fb3a7c21826a621215e is 2-of-4 and getModulesPaginated reaches the terminal sentinel with an empty list at this pin. This resolves current topology, not complete historical incident or governor/vote-source bypass review. Continuous ledger reconciliation remains internal-ledger accounting, not independent assurance of offchain receivables against liabilities. Open security findings are fork-testing findings, not evidence of live mint compromise or absence. Existing unbounded minter-authorization economics are preserved: USDfr.mint is role-gated without the controller's reserve check, and DEFAULT_ADMIN can authorize another minter. No remediation, signer independence, incident-free posture or D29 execution certificate is asserted.
unresolvedQuestions: Current timelock root roles, treasury Safe topology and canonical oracle proxy binding are now pinned. Complete the historical USDfr issuance/upgrade incident review and the governor plus mutable sGROVE vote-source permission/bypass inventory before asserting aggregate reviewComplete or incidentState none.
